## Auth (as declared by the spec)

- `api.bearer`: type=`http`, scheme=`bearer`, bearerFormat=`string`

- **api.count** — `count` (query, integer) — Specify how many records to be returned per page.
- **api.from** — `from` (query, integer) — Filter results where the id is greater than the value provided. Used together with `to` to retrieve records from a range.

- **api.person.sortBy** — `sortBy` (query, string ∈ {"id", "lastName", "firstName", "fullName", "company", "createdAt", "updatedAt", "salary"}) — The field that should be used to sort the results. The direction can be specified with the `sortOrder` parameter.

- **api.tags** — `tags[]` (query, integer[]) — Filter the results with certain tags. If more than one tag is specified then results matching any of the tags will be returned.
- **api.to** — `to` (query, integer) — Filter results where the id is equal to or less than the value provided. Used together with `from` to retrieve records from a range.

### `api.links`

Useful links for accessing other pages.

| field | type | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | string |  | Fetch the first page of results. |
| `last` | string |  | Fetch the last page of results. |
| `next` | string |  | Fetch the next page of results. |
| `prev` | string |  | Fetch the previous page of results. |

### `api.pageMeta`

Meta data about the results and pages

| field | type | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currentPage` | integer |  | The current page returned. |
| `from` | integer |  | The index of the first item in this response. |
| `lastPage` | integer |  | The last page number. |
| `path` | string |  | The base URL path for this route. |
| `perPage` | integer |  | The number of items returned in each page. |
| `to` | integer |  | The index of the last item in this response. |
| `total` | integer |  | The total number of results across all pages. |
| `unfilteredTotal` | integer |  | The total number of available items of this type. |
